messages.subject: Error when stacking data for a spatio-temporal model
parts:
Dear list,

This message deals with coding problem, not a software nor theoretical
one, so there might be little interest for most of you. But if a good
samaritain could have a look at my code and point me towards my
mistake(s), he / she 'll be very welcome...

I would like to model a spatial variable Y (count data, zero inflated...
but negbin likelihood seems to do the job correctly) for which we have
n= 4 temporal replicates. The sampling locations of these replicates
vary from year to year, according to a set of covariates.

I started to fit a model on one year and it gave pretty sensible
results. I'm now in the process of stacking the data for the
spatio-temporal model and I can't figure out where I 'm making a
mistake. Though I thought I understood how these 2 objects were created
(technically speaking), there is an obvious discrepancy between the mesh
index and the A matrix...

Here is a link ( https://www.dropbox.com/s/q6b2dku0n22itj3/InlaList.zip
) towards a folder with a short R script and a subset of the original data.

Thanks in advance for any hint.

Best regards

Alex
